purpose: Provenance for the released and recipe-only artifacts: each row gives the file path, its SHA-256, how it was produced, and notes. Verify each artifact against its hash before use.

method.numerics: TransformerBridge, tl_compatibility_mode=False, bfloat16, resid cast to float32 before projection
method.heldout_source_proportions: lmsys 31532 / pile 9124 / common_corpus 3593 / isotonic 3025 = 47274 (the §6.2 window mix; disclosed)
method.pile_substitution: monology/pile-uncopyrighted stands in for 'a subset of The Pile' (disclosed)
method.token_cap: 2048 Gemma tokens per document; percentile thresholds computed over the capped token population (disclosed)

artifacts.notes: Canonical identity of the vectors (100-topic re-extraction). Any pipeline must reproduce this hash before running. Hosted in the model repo on Hugging Face.

artifacts.produced_by: generated by claude-sonnet-4-5 (released as a generation recipe; see Appendix A)
artifacts.notes: Disjointness-gate reference; the 205,200-story corpus is not redistributed (released as a generation recipe).
Canonical neutral dialogue set (neutral_sha256 pin). Gates the shipped neutral_dialogues.jsonl; a stale or control copy fails this hash.
Rebuilt from the seeded recipe under the upstream sources' terms; not redistributed. Verify by this hash.
Seeds, per-source counts, rejection counts, extraction notes, corpus sha256.
Per-doc Gemma token counts; per-source token totals (§6.2 token-level baseline); cap cost table (2048 vs 4096 decision point).
Top-20 (doc_id, pos, value) per emotion + run config + input hashes.
Per-emotion activation histograms over all corpus tokens. Source of the 90th-percentile shading thresholds (any convention derivable).

artifacts.hosted_at: https://huggingface.co/adamhollowell/gemma-emotion-vectors (file: pertoken_stripped.tar) — 549 MB, exceeds GitHub's 100 MB per-file limit; fetch into the path above before running the Figure-1 / §8 analyses, then verify against sha256.
artifacts.notes: Text-stripped: one npz per winning document with token ids, full (seq x 171) float16 projections, random-direction projections, norms, and doc_id/source labels; readable token strings removed per the pertoken governance ruling. The source text-bearing tar (sha 0f59a745…) is not redistributed.
Not shipped (carries third-party text); windows (value, peak_pos, window, peak_token) extended with doc_id, source, per-token proj values.
